comments.1: Listen for the promise Melos makes to the ruler.
comments.2: Melos has promised to return before sunset, and his friend is waiting in his place. What will Melos do when the journey becomes harder than he expected?
comments.3: Melos has fallen, and for a moment, staying there seems easier than going on. What will make him try to reach the city again?
